name: Sensors and interfaces

test_point.convention: A single native passive pin ending directly at an open circle.

hall_sensor.convention: Generic powered Hall sensor with H and an incoming B arrow; not a bare four-terminal Hall element.

piezo_sensor.convention: Existing capacitor electrodes and terminals with a central piezo element and force arrow; generic transducer, not an ordinary crystal resonator.

light_sensor.convention: Powered photodetector interface containing the existing diode body and two incoming light arrows.

pressure_sensor.convention: Powered sensor block containing a diaphragm and incoming pressure arrow; generic conditioned voltage output.

temperature_sensor.convention: Powered temperature-to-voltage interface with a thermometer motif; distinct from a thermistor.

moisture_sensor.convention: Two interleaved resistive electrodes and water-drop motif; no supply pin or invented digital interface.

ph_probe.convention: Two-terminal pH electrode interface drawn as a labelled source circle; signal and reference remain distinct.

controlled_switch.convention: Open analogue switch contacts with a dashed actuation link and a separate differential control pair.

am_modulator.convention: Labelled AM functional block with multiplier motif and separate carrier/message differential inputs; carrier bias and modulation law require an explicit model.

notes: Original generic teaching artwork informed by manufacturer circuit conventions. Embedded configurable educational SPICE equivalents model sensing stimuli, switch controls and AM bias/index. Pin numbers are logical, not manufacturer package assignments.
